targets.title: The incremental validity of average state self-reports over global self-reports of personality.
targets.evidence_quote: First, we aimed at replicating the results of Finnigan and Vazire (2018). As in the original study, we used global informant-reported personality as a criterion variable and considered the relationship with global self-reports and average self-reported states.
targets.outcome_quote: Across all studies, the original results (i.e., no incremental effects of average self-reported states) were replicated.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors state an overall successful replication across all five studies; matching the original null finding is successful. Peer-reported states are explicitly an extension, not an opposing replication result.

reasoning: Five samples independent of the original paper re-test both original studies' result. Already collected data are from different samples, not a re-analysis of Finnigan and Vazire's own data. One target paper. Study 1 includes time-based (1A) and event-based (1B) parts; the five paper-level replication study numbers are listed.
